description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The New Jersey Department of Transportation is hiring a Software Development Specialist 1 for its Division of Information Technology, Office of Emerging Technology. The role develops and maintains workflows and cloud-based solutions, supports existing information technology services, and contributes to artificial intelligence initiatives.
Software Engineering Specialist 1 develops enterprise workflows and SaaS/IaaS/PaaS solutions, analyzes systems, and supports financial/procurement rewrites

Responsibilities:
• Developing and maintaining new and existing process workflows
• Developing cloud - based solutions (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS)
• Programming knowledge in ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, PYTHON, PowerShell SCRIPT, and other languages as necessary to support existing workflow systems
• Performing system/business analysis and documenting business needs and requirements
• Collaborating with IT vendors
• Working with the main enterprise systems and participating in the re - writing of financial and procurement systems
• Perform system studies for the development of new systems
• Participating in Artificial Intelligence related planning and design documentation
• Coordinates and works with unit supervisor and other team members

Requirements:
• Web based programming knowledge such as ASP.NET, CSS, HTML, PYTHON AND POWERSHELL SCRIPTING
• Knowledge of cloud REST API integration
• Knowledge of programming functionality and skills to troubleshoot a software issue
• Software architecture skills that can leverage a business requirement into a process solution
• Knowledge of cloud data structure
• Excellent analytical, problem identification, and resolution skills
• Knowledge of database design principles
• Knowledge of M365 copilot, Generative AI and Agentic AI
• Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models
• Good oral and written communication skills that allow accurate translation of user recommendations into information technology products
• Five (5) years of professional experience in programming, systems programming or computer analysis
• Possession of a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; and one (1) year of the above - mentioned professional experience
• Possession of a master's degree in an Information Technology field
• Appointees will be required to possess a driver's license valid in New Jersey
• Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States according to the Department of Homeland Security, United States Citizenship and Immigration Services regulations
• NJDOT does not provide sponsorship or accept student OPT/CPT program, F1 or H1B work authorization visas
